score_label: LLM rubric score, fresh-context judge, self-assessed — not human QA
independence_caveat: This judge did not read pipeline/prompts/generate.md and did not author the lesson, so it cannot mark against intent. It is not fully naive: the same session directed the project at a scope level and set several of its constraints. That is weaker independence than the rubric assumes, and is stated here rather than left for a reader to discover.
